items.text: Music business and artist management careers cover managing artists, running live events, working at labels and publishing firms, handling rights and royalties and marketing releases, and they reward organisation, trust, contracts knowledge and a network built over years.
Learn how rights, royalties and contracts work, manage a small act or event to build a record and choose between management, events, label or rights work.
Read agreements carefully and take legal advice before signing any music contract.
